name: Food insecurity rate
source: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps 2025 County Health Release, Monterey County (Map the Meal Gap measure)
notes: This is a Monterey County proxy permitted by portrait scale policy, not a Carmel-by-the-Sea city-limit measurement. The captured CHR 2025 county-layer record for FIPS 06053 reports v139_rawvalue = 13% and numerator = 56,940; the field metadata identifies Map the Meal Gap and explicitly dates the estimate to 2022. CHR defines the denominator as the total county population. Tier 1 City/local searches and Tier 2 state/federal searches did not yield this modeled city-limit measure; the CHR county series is a tier-3 research-institution source. The modeled all-population measure is distinct from self-reported household food stress.
